MLB Pitching Statistics

PitchingPreview.Rd

A dataset containing MLB player pitching statistics used by PlayerPredictorMLB to identify similar player seasons from 2021-2026. This is a preview of the internal data.

Usage

PitchingPreview

Format

A data frame with 25 rows and 37 variables:

Name

Player name.

Team

Team the player played for during a particular season. Listed as "—" if they played for multiple teams.

W

Pitcher wins.

L

Pitcher losses.

SV

Pitcher saves.

G

Games pitched.

GS

Games started.

IP

Innings pitched.

K/9

Strikeouts per nine innings pitched.

BB/9

Walks per nine innings pitched.

HR/9

Home runs per nine innings pitched.

BABIP

Opponents batting average on balls in play.

HR/FB

Home runs per fly ball.

vFA (pi)

Fastball velocity.

ERA

Earned run average.

xERA

Expected earned run average.

FIP

Fielding independent pitching.

xFIP

Expected fielding independent pitching.

WAR

Wins above replacement.

Season

The season the stat line occurred in.

Age

The player's official age for the season.

AVG

Opponents' batting average.

LOB%

Left-on-base percentagee

GB%

The percentage of a pitcher’s balls in play that are ground balls.

K%

Percentage of plate appearances that are strikeouts.

BB%

Percent of plate appearances that are walks.

K-BB%

Strikeout percentage minus walk percentage.

Barrel%

Percent of a pitcher's batted balls that are classified as a barrel.

HardHit%

Percentage of a player's batted balls that are classified as hard hit balls.

BB

Walks.

SO

Strikeouts.

WHIP

Walks and hits per inning pitched.

NameASCII

Player name using only ASCII characters.

PlayerId

Unique player identifier that can be used to link to other datasets that use PlayerID.

MLBAMID

Unique player identifier called Major League Baseball Advanced Media ID that can be used to link to other datasets that use MLBAMID.

Is Starter

Manually added binary variable that classifies a player season as a starting pitcher.

Is Reliever

Manually added binary variable that classifies a player season as a relief pitcher.

Source

FanGraphs.com
